title: Restore a bounded cross-thread deadlock guard for the publication busy-state regression
outcome: A regression to blocking StateInner acquisition fails the busy-state publication test with a bounded diagnosis instead of self-deadlocking.
acceptance: The busy-state publication test holds contention from another thread or runs publication under the established DEADLOCK_GUARD while retaining injected-clock wait assertions.
The fixture still verifies custody release and state progress under contention; it does not use real60s sleeps or weaken the existing busy/error behavior.
